limitations: Original user-authorized #11 source-qualification research organization. This is a finite inventory of discovered sources with access and rights evidence, not a new source-engineering registry or a claim to have exhausted all Internet data and histories.

The original compact metadata inventory uses shared URL, text, rights and response-receipt catalogues. All original elements and zero-based indexes are retained losslessly across these sections. An isolated source record may depend on catalogue elements in another part; do not resolve it against only the local section.

No numerical samples or original business-response bodies are in this metadata version. Dataset facts, where permissible, are separately retained with actual write/read receipts. HTTP success, local bytes, verified numbers, native custody and executed consumers are different states.

Counts of institutions, families, products, endpoints, observations and table rows differ. Preserve original scopes, upstream duplication, revisions, forecasts, missing observations, login requirements and publication restrictions. Public availability does not imply a blanket reuse licence.

The frozen researcher runtime statements apply to the qualification stage. The root session actual SourceRef and native reader overlay is maintained separately. No monitoring scheduler, alert, investment decision or trade is created.
